scope: Implementation/evidence crosswalk only; not an acceptance PASS ledger or human balance approval.
productionState: Core/App and both numeric catalogs frozen. Current tests and pilots below ran against their recorded exact content and assembly identities; native presentation and release integration are independently owned.

originalAudit.title: Shop money displays and some limits bypass canonical content
originalAudit.detail: Typed canonical prices, mixed slot limits and pure QuotePreparation drive atomic cost; no runtime bank authorizer. Isolated item1900/cap2400 fixture quotes and debits2200 consistently. UI/App integration is independently owned.

originalAudit.title: Simultaneous command throws lack an explicit second-pass arbitration
originalAudit.detail: Immutable mutual command grabs clash symmetrically; mixed command/normal resolves command priority; normal-normal tech; mirrored actual input and every-tick reconstruction.

originalAudit.title: Air parry arm can survive a landing transition
originalAudit.detail: Air parry requires airborne state, clears on landing, and cannot leak through landing recovery into grounded low/overhead defense.

originalAudit.title: Taunt bypasses the normal action-start parry cleanup
originalAudit.detail: Taunt requires grounded actionable unfrozen actor, clears parry and buffers, and commits24ticks without retained defense.

originalAudit.title: Hurt silhouettes are generic outside active hitbox extension
originalAudit.detail: Move-authored half-open hurtbox_windows supply independent body/limb vulnerability during startup/active/recovery and freeze with action clock. New recipes preserve explicit disjoint and recovery roles.
originalAudit.remaining: Paused native overlays and human whiff-punish/silhouette calibration are separate; these numeric shapes are authored gameplay seeds, not automatically traced art.

originalAudit.title: Midair facing and blocked posture transitions need feel validation
originalAudit.detail: Horizontal facing/charge epoch stays committed airborne; grounded landing updates facing. Current high/low guard input controls posture during blockstop/stun.
originalAudit.remaining: Subjective original-feel comparison requires adapted human play; no exact Third Strike emulation claim.

originalAudit.title: Roster and content shape are hardcoded across layers
originalAudit.detail: Semantic registry bounds replace fixed two-fighter/49move/12item restrictions; test-only thirdfighter1250HP and extra stage validate and enter two-seat simulation.
originalAudit.remaining: Only Thomas and Vincent are production characters; third fixture is not a new shipped character.

originalAudit.title: Global character-stat purchases are absent and should not be silently introduced
originalAudit.detail: Products grant explicit actions or one finite art use; validator rejects passive system-defense products. No global purchased health/damage/speed/income modifiers.

originalAudit.title: Vale Long Check needs a demonstrated advantage over free Long Heel
originalAudit.detail: Later approved buyables catalog replaces original Long Check with Needle Check: a300-price thin mid, explicit reach and recovering limb, no low profile/knockdown/kara/outgoing cancel.
originalAudit.remaining: Actual buy/save pilot measures use/contact/outcome; a price-justified human anti-poke niche is not established by activation or static geometry alone.

originalAudit.title: Returning Pulse is a one-contact returning threat with owner-wide projectile constraints
originalAudit.detail: Returning Pulse reverses only after a miss, one contact consumes it on hit/block/parry, and shared ordinary-shot occupancy rejects licensed EX/selected-super projectile attempts before consuming use.
originalAudit.remaining: Human setup value and final price remain provisional.

originalAudit.title: Selected-super prices create major access differences not justified by slot order
originalAudit.detail: Shop-only v2 replaces old4/3/2 purchased-startup arithmetic with one prepaid use total. All six core arts have exact shop thresholds, actual hit/block/parry/whiff traces and repeated exhausted intent; advanced Overtime/Prism replace fullcatalog third arts.
originalAudit.remaining: Different arts need adapted human confirm/reversal/positioning value review; equal damage and balanced prices are not asserted.

originalAudit.title: A 300-credit opening award gap can cross a decisive affordability threshold
originalAudit.detail: The approved v2 schedule removes the old300 award gap; pending skill and retained spend can still differ.64score1-0 continuations pair earned-gap versus equal-bank states with0/600 prior-spend fixtures across four isolated controls. Round2 and eventual-match deltas retain seed-block uncertainty.
originalAudit.remaining: The assumed round1 skill receipts300/100 are explicit fixture inputs. All-art/loadout factorial and trailer-top-up versus leader-reduction equivalence are not established.

originalAudit.title: Recovery may restore liquidity only after severe score disadvantage
originalAudit.detail: 48full matches plus64continuations record every settlement and flag whether the next shop is usable. Analysis separately inventories observed0-1,0-2,0-3,0-4 continuing states and excludes terminal wallets from comeback liquidity.
originalAudit.remaining: Only1-0 has paired economic interventions; deeper-deficit states are observations, not causal comeback experiments. Human value of liquidity remains open.

originalAudit.title: Residual spending differences can snowball independently of the win bonus
originalAudit.detail: Every trace starts from an explicit bank/score snapshot and contains atomic preparation plans, actual frozen-bank fight inputs, and confirmed outcome/skill grants. Buy/save pairs retain the exact fee; score1-0 treatments hold prior spending fixed.
originalAudit.remaining: The bounded pilot does not model a complete taxonomy of efficient winners, failed human reversals, or asymmetric spending histories.

originalAudit.title: Full-rental plans and combat budgets need explicit opportunity-cost comparisons
originalAudit.detail: 800actual rounds compare all38single products and12two-EX pairs to buying nothing at equal opening bank2400. Every product has an actual startup witness and paired seed-block outcome estimate; retained cash stays in the same bank.
originalAudit.remaining: Full mixed rental/license/art cart factorial and human opportunity-cost decisions are not exhausted. Single rounds cannot establish match-level purchase value.

originalAudit.title: Unlimited per-round rental use makes duration and repeat pressure central to value
originalAudit.detail: Observed uses, contact outcomes, round lengths and full command traces are retained. Repeatable EX is additionally exercised at zero bank with ordinary recovery/charge rules and80corner response cells.
originalAudit.remaining: Short/long contextual value, deterrence and adapted repeated pressure remain human balance questions; frequent activation alone is not treated as value.

originalAudit.title: Raw first-round-winner conversion is confounded by score and player strength
originalAudit.detail: Reports separate the analytical score-only163/256 benchmark from measured results and paired score-preserving interventions. Counterbalanced seats are averaged within seed blocks; with two chosen seeds the conditional intervals remain broad.
originalAudit.remaining: No50percent first-winner conversion target or population human balance conclusion. Stage, art and player-pair blocking is incomplete.

originalAudit.title: Earlier parity payout variants need isolated versioned experiments
originalAudit.detail: Approved v2 uses four isolated controls: A historical payouts/no skills, B historical/capped skills, C shipping parity/capped skills, D parity/no skills. C is byte-identical to shipping; all variant files and hashes are retained.48fresh matches plus64continuations are reconstructed.
originalAudit.remaining: This is a representative pilot, not final balance approval. Crossover policies consumed zero super uses, so those matches do not measure art-frequency effects; separate product rounds and conformance cover actual arts.

originalAudit.title: Economic telemetry should expose affordability and payout history rather than wallet totals alone
originalAudit.detail: Every observed round exports pre-settlement bank, nominal/granted/clipped result payout, old/new recovery tier, separate earned/granted/clipped skills, score and continuing-state usability. Analysis verifies both seats' settlement equations; full command traces reconstruct preparation debits and every bank-frozen fight tick.
originalAudit.remaining: Owned-threat utility is distinct from bank totals. UI ledger rendering is independently verified; mathematical state counts are never presented as played matches.

originalAudit.title: Zero-credit legal actions do not prove adequate answers to funded chip and pressure
originalAudit.detail: All 8 EX across 2 facings and 5 real responses at a 100 HP zero-bank cornered defender. 80 reconstructed cells retain damage, survival and failed responses: 64 survivals, 14/16 scripted parry successes. Rook Pulse EX predictor missed its close spawn at both facings; this is not labeled impossible to parry.
originalAudit.remaining: Predictive scripts are not human reaction measurements. All-art low-health corner sequences and adaptive mixed rental/EX pressure are not exhausted by these EX cells; conventional art defense tests are separate.

originalAudit.title: A locked reserve can suppress a comeback or final-round cash-out unintentionally
originalAudit.detail: V2 has no active reserve floor. Nonzero compatibility parameter rejects atomically; ownership and finite use alone authorize enhanced actions.
